beats.say: Before there was anything... there was God.
In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
Now the earth was formless and void, and darkness was over the surface of the deep.
And the Spirit of God was hovering over the surface of the waters.
Then God spoke.
And God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.
On the second day, He spread out the sky above the waters.
On the third day, the seas pulled back... and dry land rose up.
Then God said, “Let the earth bring forth vegetation”
On the fourth day, He hung the sun and the moon in place.
And He made the stars as well.
On the fifth day, the oceans came alive, and the skies filled with wings.
On the sixth day, the land filled with creatures of every kind.
And then He made us.
So God created man in His own image; in the image of God He created him; male and female He created them.
And God looked upon all that He had made, and indeed, it was very good.
And on the seventh day, He rested.
Maybe your life feels formless right now. Empty. Dark.
But the God who spoke light into the very first darkness... has not stopped speaking.
The Light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not overcome it.
Let there be light. In you.
